title: Goodbye to the dog
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Thursday. Chloe says goodbye to the dog first. On the porch. She does it properly, on her knees. Wood watches from the bottom step and the strip gives him nothing to say.

panels.composition: Chloe's porch, rain. CHLOE on her knees on the top step with BARNABY, one, in her hands, his face in hers. WOOD on the bottom step.

characters.pose: on her knees with the dog
